g.text: 761,995 patient-hours; 10 supplied score bins, 0 empty. Empty-bin calibration points are omitted.

text.style: font-size: 8.3px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #52636b

g.text: Distribution bars show the fraction of all reported B patient-hours; bin-level intervals were not supplied.

g.text: Scores target the supplied shifted hourly label, including post-onset hours; this is not a pure future-onset probability.
